IC-25.label: single-source-high-confidence
IC-25.rule: Entity resolved from a single source with high-confidence match.

IC-40.label: multi-source-consistent
IC-40.rule: Entity resolved from multiple sources with consistent attributes.

IC-70.label: multi-source-conflict-precedence-applied
IC-70.rule: Entity resolved from multiple sources with conflicting attributes; field-level precedence applied.

IC-90.label: contested-unresolved
IC-90.rule: Entity is contested; identifier watchlist case remains unresolved.

OR-15.label: all-channels-ready
OR-15.rule: All channels usable and consent granted.

OR-35.label: channels-usable-consent-pending
OR-35.rule: At least one channel usable; consent pending.

OR-60.label: channels-usable-consent-denied
OR-60.rule: At least one channel usable; consent denied.

OR-80.label: no-usable-channel
OR-80.rule: No usable channel regardless of consent.

FP-20.label: single-source
FP-20.rule: All fields sourced from a single system of record.

FP-55.label: multi-source-majority-survivor
FP-55.rule: Fields sourced from multiple systems; survivor row carries the majority.

FP-75.label: multi-source-significant-conflict
FP-75.rule: Fields sourced from multiple systems; significant field-level conflict required precedence rules.

RB-17.label: clean-one-to-one
RB-17.rule: Alias maps cleanly to exactly one canonical category.

RB-42.label: deprecated-superseded
RB-42.rule: Alias is deprecated or retired; superseded by a newer reference.

RB-83.label: ambiguous-non-standard
RB-83.rule: Alias is ambiguous or maps to a non-standard category.

SB-24.label: authoritative-only
SB-24.rule: Record appears only in the authoritative (CERTIFIED) snapshot.

SB-61.label: multi-snapshot-authoritative-retained
SB-61.rule: Record appears in multiple snapshots; authoritative copy retained.

SB-79.label: provisional-only
SB-79.rule: Record appears only in a non-authoritative (PROVISIONAL) snapshot.

LD-14.label: clean-ledger-entry
LD-14.rule: Transaction is valid, recognized, and enters the ledger cleanly.

LD-31.label: mismatch-flagged
LD-31.rule: Transaction has a category mismatch but is otherwise valid; enters ledger with a flag.

LD-53.label: unrecognized-manual-review
LD-53.rule: Transaction is unrecognized; routed for manual review.

LD-72.label: quarantined
LD-72.rule: Transaction is quarantined (invalid quantity, ambiguous category, or other quality block).

LD-88.label: duplicate-excluded
LD-88.rule: Transaction is a duplicate and excluded from the ledger.

MS-12.label: telematics-onboard
MS-12.rule: Event sourced from telematics / onboard system.

MS-47.label: workshop-third-party
MS-47.rule: Event sourced from workshop / third-party service provider.

MS-86.label: manual-correction
MS-86.rule: Event sourced from manual entry or correction log.

HR-19.label: valid-included
HR-19.rule: Event passes all validation checks; included in corrected history.

HR-33.label: corrected-retained
HR-33.rule: Event corrected (e.g., odometer adjusted) but retained.

HR-74.label: rejected-excluded
HR-74.rule: Event rejected; excluded from corrected history.
